route: C: observation-conditioned warm initializer for three-dimensional BOST reconstruction
headline: v96 adds four observation-adaptive spectral-band directions and independently validates truth-aware representation capacity on all 90 Case 6 cells
headline_zh: v96 用四个只由观测残差与已知几何生成的频谱方向，把 Case 6 的 truth-aware 表示容量补到 90/90；这是表示容量突破，但还不是可部署算法成功。
next_scientific_gate: freeze and independently validate a minimal observation-only predictor for the four new spectral-band coefficients under the same five-fold embargoed 90-cell eight-gate and 2A+2AT contract; only a 90/90 result authorizes one unopened public external condition
next_scientific_gate_zh: 冻结最小 observation-only 四系数预测器：只读取 observation、known geometry 与父残差频谱特征，保持同一五折隔离、90 单元、八门和 2A+2A^T 在线预算；只有预测结果也达到 90/90，才打开一个此前未读的公开外部工况。
